blocks.md: **The share of the US wage bill paid to college workers rose from about 20% in 1967 to 54.7% in 2017. Almost all of the 34.7 pp increase happened within industries.**

| Component | Contribution |
| --- | --- |
| Between industries (college-intensive industries grew) | ≈ 1.1 pp |
| Within industries (industries became more college-intensive) | ≈ 33.6 pp |
| **Total** | **34.7 pp** |
1967 is the first year with consistent `ind90ly` industry codes.
This is accounting, not causation. See the caveats in [Shift-Share Decomposition](note:shift-share-decomposition).
